requirements.requirement: The system must include a sponsor_credibility object in the clinical trials evaluation API response.
The system must populate sponsor_credibility.score using the output from EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-LOGIC-001.
The system must populate sponsor_credibility.classification as a normalized categorical value (e.g., high, medium, low).
The system must include a human-readable sponsor_credibility.explanation field in the API response.
The system must ensure the sponsor_credibility object conforms to the schema defined in EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-SCHEMA-001.
The system must integrate sponsor_credibility into the evaluate_care_facade response without breaking existing response structure.
The system must return sponsor_credibility for every clinical trial that has sponsor data available.
The system must generate explanation text that explicitly references sponsor type and funding source.
The system must ensure explanation text is concise and does not exceed 300 characters.
The system must ensure explanation text contains no raw ClinicalTrials.gov field names (e.g., lead_sponsor, collaborator).
The system must produce deterministic explanation text for identical sponsor input data.
The system must default sponsor_credibility.classification to 'unknown' when sponsor data is missing.
The system must return sponsor_credibility.score as null when scoring logic fails or returns no value.
The system must include an explanation indicating insufficient data when sponsor or funding information is missing.
